candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are unlike.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as a whole plus zero fractional part or a standard mixed number, so whole and fractional parts can be subtracted.
candidate_skills.alignment_notes: A.S02, B.S02, and C.S02 all cover preparatory rewriting of whole numbers and mixed numbers into compatible forms for subtraction, including n + 0/d and normalizing improper mixed forms.

candidate_skills.canonical_definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number and fractional parts separately once the quantities are in compatible form.
